intent: Implement the user-approved split between strict canonical truth and more useful researcher interpretation. Keep CAP-0003/CAP-0004 source-time, Reality/Judgment/Outcome and no-lookahead semantics hard; extend CAP-0005 so read models may expose deterministic time/usefulness hints and related-milestone interpretation without mutating underlying records; reuse CAP-0006 current research-only hypotheses as the explicitly labelled MODEL/JUDGMENT lane for analytical claims such as causality, participant importance or ambiguous role. Remove blanket presentation prohibitions that treated all inference as equally unsafe, while preserving an absolute ban on silently promoting inference into source truth.
rationale: The tightening review found three coupled over-restrictions. First, role/importance/causality were bundled into a blanket presentation ban even though deterministic entailment and labelled model analysis have different authority classes. Second, source-supported temporal precision correctly constrained canonical Reality but was being treated too much like a ban on useful researcher time hints. Third, related milestones correctly could not satisfy a direct Outcome target, yet presentation could surface their information value more clearly. Existing CAP-0005 read projection and CAP-0006 research-hypothesis semantics are sufficient; no new truth owner or schema is needed.
